stem: One irrigation zone remains saturated while comparable zones have begun drying. The schedule calls for another event soon. What is the best Technician I action?
choices: Run the scheduled event without checking because timing is fixed
Document the abnormal wetness and follow the exception/escalation procedure before adding more irrigation
Move the saturated plants to another room without recording the issue
rationale: Prolonged saturation can create root-zone risk. A technician should not blindly add water when observed conditions conflict with the routine schedule.
